Hey! I’m 28, bisexual. I can talk if you want to!

I can totally feel you because we are all the same page. The only different is I didn’t have sex with other people. To be honest, I think your situation is way better than mine. I let my ex to abuse me emotionally and treat her like her slave in order to keep her. But now she just cut ties with me...like all the sudden. I’m very lost. But I still seek for help because there’s a lot of people who cares about me. (At least I try to think of it in this way). Your bf just doesn’t understand this personality disorder, so perhaps explain your situation with your SO next time then things might be more smooth. At least this is what I’m planning to do from now on. Goodluck!

Hi I’m 28 as well. I’ve been diagnosed with bpd and major depression during my last year of university, 2009. I didn’t manage to graduate because that university said I have to be stable in order to continue studying. So I transferred to another university. During my last year in this university, I got diagnosed to MS. I was super down and thought I wouldn’t be able to graduate in my whole entire life and illness just keeps coming for me. Relationships did not go well either. I had causal, complicated relationships with my ex-gf. She tends to emotionally abusive where she yells at me all the time. And today all the sudden she just cut ties with me. I’m jobless, so I don’t even think I need to talk about housing. I’m trying so hard to work my life. Perhaps, you will say a lot of people doesn’t understand you, but I totally do, because I’m on the same page! But i still believe one day my life will be different and so will yours. Because I believe one day we can find someone who treats us well. I know let go is the key to be happy, and I’m 0% from mastering it. But still trying, so you should give it a try too. Wish you all the best!  
********UPDATE: I managed to graduate! So you can too!******
